player_intent: Rebuild source-backed SOCOM II locomotion and action blending in the actual game.
acceptance_rule: The enabled rifle policy selects native SEAL walk/jog/run from actual velocity, the driver agrees with the graph, related source spaces share cycle phase, and all three native pistol reload routes preserve accepted-action timing and trigger-hand contact. This is the first controller stage, not certified PS2 parity.

visual_check: Main scene modern rifle: slow analog walk, jog, full run, diagonals, rapid reversals, stop, crouch, fire and reload. Then Mark23 reload all postures. Check feet, torso and trigger-hand contact. Compare original game before declaring 1:1.

system_delta.reason: Use source-selected tiers and shared phase inside existing animation owner. Retain movement/camera/server contracts. Weighting law remains a labeled inference pending original runtime evidence.
